narrative: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 launches as a closed-weight Mythos-class tier above Opus, shipped as a routed, terms-enforced public release paired with an unrestricted partners-only twin withheld from everyone else. remaining_gap: One lab's launch does not establish the prediction's specific markers: two-plus frontier labs going API-only and an open-weight ceiling settling at the 35B-A3B class.
